It’s really hard to choose just one favorite post-rock track—there are so
many great songs by so many amazing bands. But if I had to pick only
one, I would choose “Glósóli” by Sigur Rós. I still remember buying the
album as soon as it was released and feeling an overwhelming sense of
freedom and inspiration. The gradual build-up through repetition, the
rhythmic percussion, and the slightly overdriven, saturated textures all
felt fresh and unlike the post-rock I used to listen to at the time.
This is also a song that you must watch with its music video. After seeing
it, I felt I understood the song’s structure and emotion even more deeply.
The scene where the children jump off the cliff and fly into the sky
particularly struck me, and it actually inspired part of our band Wings of
the ISANG (이상의날개)’s first album. In our song “Crimson Sky”, the
melodic explosion in the middle section was created while I imagined
myself leaping from a cliff and flying into the sky - just like in the Glósóli
video. Knowing this might help listeners better understand the emotion-
al flow of “Crimson Sky”.
Anyway, Glósóli had a deep influence on me long ago, and it brings back
many memories to revisit it now.

我常常说听Tortoise的歌，需要一些仪式感让自己先沉静
下来，比如我可能会洗个澡。
一直以来乌龟的音乐在乐手中被视为“圣经”一样的存
在，他们的想象力，成员们多乐器的演奏，以及标志性的双鼓
手都给了很多乐队以启发。
新专辑《Touch》的创作周期听说横跨了疫情时期，以及
乐手们改变了以往的集体创作的模式——大家分散在美国各
地，多录音室接力的方式完成了这张专辑。这也是我想推荐的
原因，一个存在了三十多年的乐队依然在突破和拓宽自己的边
界。
《Layered Presence》一开始的打击乐便让人觉得耳目一
新，非常规的打击乐器很有可能来自于某一个不起眼的生活用
品，随之而来的是由鼓组律动和电子氛围包裹的标志性键盘音
色，低音的推进让整首歌充满了难以捉摸，却又有一丝站在神
性空间里静静接受时间洗礼的感觉。副歌部分短暂的吉他在整
首歌里像一把形状怪异，却精准无比的刀子一样，分割但是又
巧妙连接了核心的旋律。这也是乌龟这只乐队最擅长的表达方
式。
《Layered Presence》从歌名来看，有在多重现实夹缝中
寻找自我存在的冲突感，而这种冲突感表现在乌龟的音乐里却
